name: hinfnorm
comment: Sig: g = hinfnorm(sys). H-infinity norm ||G||inf = sup_w sigma_max(G(jw)) of a continuous-time LTI system via the Bruinsma-Steinbuch Hamiltonian test with bisection on gamma (gamma is an upper bound iff M(gamma)=[A+BR^-1D'C, BR^-1B'; -C'(I+DR^-1D')C, -(...)'] has no purely imaginary eigenvalue, R=gamma^2 I - D'D). Eigenvalues of M via charPoly->roots (the pole path); no frequency sweep (the test is exact). Returns Inf for unstable / jw-axis poles. Fingerprint: g1=1 (1/(s+1)), g3=10.012523 (lightly-damped resonance), g4=0.83333 (static peak), g5=1.5 (D=0.5). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Discrete-time deferred. Fixes bugs/control/hinfnorm.
